title: Implement deterministic Work-monitor transition planning
objective: Create a pure deterministic integration layer that maps persisted orchestration state plus an observed Cursor commit/CI/review outcome into exactly one idempotent monitor decision and next state. It performs no external I/O.
acceptance_criteria: Export CI_STATUSES containing exactly None, queued, in_progress, success, failure, cancelled.
Export REVIEW_OUTCOMES containing exactly None, pass, mechanical-failure, human-required.

Export process_monitor_observation(state, *, candidate_commit=None, ci_status=None, review_outcome=None) returning a dict with decision and state, and optionally attempt_key when a correction is dispatched.
The function validates the input with orchestration_state.validate_state and never mutates the input.
If human_required is true or pending_action is human, return decision human-required with unchanged logical state.
If there is no active task, return decision noop with unchanged logical state.

When pending_action is await-agent, no/empty/duplicate candidate commit returns noop; a new candidate commit is recorded through record_processed_commit with pending_action await-ci and decision commit-recorded.

When pending_action is await-ci, a missing last_processed_commit is rejected as inconsistent state; None/queued/in_progress CI returns decision ci-pending without state mutation; success/failure/cancelled advances pending_action to review and returns decision ready-for-review.

When pending_action is review, no review_outcome returns noop; pass completes the task and returns task-passed; human-required sets pending_action human and human_required true; mechanical-failure calls begin_auto_correction and returns dispatch-correction with the new stable attempt_key, unless retries are exhausted in which case it returns human-required.
Unsupported ci_status or review_outcome raises ValueError.
Repeated processing after a persisted transition is idempotent and must not emit the same downstream action twice from the same logical state.
All transitions preserve unrelated keys in state.
human_escalation_conditions: The contract requires changing Gate 07 semantics.
External I/O appears necessary inside the pure planner.
Any file outside allowed_paths appears necessary.
